# HEM v0.6.2b6 — Restore dispatch with selected door sensors

Focused correction for repeated `authority_or_evidence_changed_before_dispatch` while native devices remain operable.

- Door observations include diagnostic elapsed ages. Those ages change with each clock read; comparing entire plans before and after storage incorrectly cancelled every start in an affected room, even when control evidence was unchanged.
- Compare plans without only the elapsed contact age. Retain an explicit transition epoch, actual state, health, source identity, stability/Eco decisions and every other control fact. All existing live rechecks, physical dwell, PID, authorization and manual overrides remain in effect.
- A real transition, missing/reassigned/restored contact, report expiry, profile/window/presence change or feedback change still cancels the unsent command. Door-open/closed chatter cannot disappear behind a matching final state.
- Refresh diagnostic entities after a proven pre-dispatch abort, even when its reason has not changed. An intent-only or retry-intent record no longer claims a confirmed command delivery or device nonresponse; uncertain interrupted commands retain their reconciliation requirements.
- Supply required name-translation placeholders on dashboard menu renders, correcting repeated missing-channel errors. Empty and explicit channels, unavailable rows and user names keep their existing presentation rules.
- Add production-dispatch regression tests with real advancing door observations, and browser translation tests in English, Greek and German. Retain the b4 startup and b5 coordination/energy tests.

No configuration reset, new control policy or Announcement Hub routing change. Install through HACS and restart Home Assistant to load the backend correction, then reload the dashboard. The release process does not operate or restart the user's devices/server.
